description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineInformation" name="Machine information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StopMachine" name="Stop machine command"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EngineerEmail" name="OEE alert email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Start measuring"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_MachineInformation" name="Collect machine information" messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEThreshold" name="Check OEE threshold" default="Flow_OEE_NotBelowThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_EngineerEmail" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_MachineDisconnected" name="Handle machine disconnection" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_To_Stopped" sourceRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_To_Calculate" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_MachineInformation" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_To_Check" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_BelowThreshold" name="OEE below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold" targetRef="SendTask_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">OEE < threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_NotBelowThreshold" name="OEE not below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_To_Email" sourceRef="SendTask_StopMachine" targetRef="SendTask_EngineerEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_To_Restart" sourceRef="SendTask_EngineerEmail" targetRef="CatchEvent_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_To_Collect" sourceRef="CatchEvent_MachineRestarted" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MachineInformation"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE" name="OEE process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineInformation" name="Machine information" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MachineInformation" messageRef="Message_MachineInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopMachine" name="Stop machine command" sourceRef="SendTask_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EngineerEmail" name="OEE alert email" sourceRef="SendTask_EngineerEmail" targetRef="Participant_Engineer" messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="CatchEvent_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="StartEvent_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
